lead_story.topic: Ole Miss beats Louisville 41-38 on walk-off FG after back-and-forth thriller — Trinidad Chambliss 4 total TDs
lead_story.headline: Ole Miss walks off Louisville in instant classic

tweets.text:
Trinidad Chambliss vs Louisville:

21-36
336 PASS YDS
60 RUSH YDS
4 TOT TD

Game. Winning. Drive.
OLE MISS WITH THE WALK-OFF, COLLEGE FOOTBALL IS BACK!!

lead_story.research_notes: Week 1 delivered Game of the Year. Ole Miss 41, Louisville 38 on walk-off FG with 0:00 left per ground truth. Trinidad Chambliss (QB from Trinidad and Tobago, 🇹🇹) put up 21-36, 336 pass yds, 60 rush yds, 4 total TD per StatMuse — a 'Game. Winning. Drive.' per StatMuse. Louisville QB Lincoln Kienholz tied it 38-38 with TD run and 2-pt conversion with 1:29 left per ESPN/ClutchPoints — his first pass TD as a Cardinal came earlier per ESPN. Ole Miss responded with a drive to set up Lucas Carneiro's walk-off FG. RedditCFB: 'OLE MISS WITH THE WALK-OFF, COLLEGE FOOTBALL IS BACK!!' HaterReport: 'ARE YOU NOT ENTERTAINED!!' The back-and-forth: Ole Miss led, Louisville came back, Ole Miss went ahead again with Chambliss 4th TD (rushing TD to go up two scores late per ClutchPoints), Louisville tied it with under 90 seconds left, Ole Miss drove for the winner. Louisville had 15 penalties including a roughing-the-kicker on a 57-yard FG attempt that gave Ole Miss a new set of downs — RedditCFB: 'Roughing the kicker in a 57-yd attempt with the game on the line is insane energy lmao.' RedditCFB also noted Louisville was 'Surprisingly good team / Very fun to watch / Undone by awful discipline / Louisville Football is BACK!' Nashville Test passed per RedditCFB. Chambliss joined SportsCenter after: 'We fought until the end, so just happy we got the win.' ESPN called it the only Sunday night game, BarstoolBigCat agreed Friday: 'I told everyone on Friday Louisville/Ole Miss was the only Sunday night game.' Week 1, ranked matchup, back-and-forth scoring, walk-off FG with 0:00 — this is the template for an instant classic. Research the last time a Week 1 CFB game had this many lead changes and ended on a walk-off FG. Compare Chambliss's 4-TD performance to other Week 1 QB performances in recent Ole Miss history — Lane Kiffin era vs current staff. Louisville's penalty count (15) — is that the most in a single game this season across all of CFB so far? The 'Nashville Test' joke from RedditCFB — Ole Miss played in Nashville, passed the test. What is the Nashville Test? (Likely a reference to neutral-site games or big-stage performance.) Kienholz's first TD as a Cardinal coming in a tied game with under two minutes left — that's a baptism by fire, research his recruiting story and how he ended up at Louisville. Carneiro (the kicker) — walk-off FGs are remembered forever, especially in Week 1. Was this his first career game-winner? Trinidad Chambliss is from Trinidad and Tobago (🇹🇹 flag in ESPN tweet) — how rare is it for a QB from the Caribbean to start and dominate in a Power conference? This has cross-sport Caribbean athlete angle (think MLB Dominican stars, NBA international rise). The meme of the game: HaterReport's 'ARE YOU NOT ENTERTAINED!!' Gladiator reference, perfect for a back-and-forth bloodbath. Gif concept: maxed-out exhaustion / can't-believe-we-survived-that. Both fanbases, both coaching staffs, everyone watching — this game had it all.

supporting_stories.topic: Notre Dame defeats Wisconsin 41-13 at Lambeau Field — Marcus Freeman goes for it on 4th & 1 up 28, Badgers call it classless
supporting_stories.headline: Notre Dame buries Wisconsin, Freeman twists knife

tweets.text:
Notre Dame RBs vs Wisconsin:

Williams —                          James Jr — 
21 touches                           11 touches        
101 total yards                    86 total yards
2 total touchdowns          1 total touchdown
That felt unnecessary by Notre Dame. Have some class

supporting_stories.research_notes: Notre Dame beat Wisconsin 41-13 at Lambeau Field per ground truth. Marcus Freeman went for it on 4th down up 28 points late in the game, BarstoolBigCat: 'That felt unnecessary by Notre Dame. Have some class' per BarstoolBigCat. Wisconsin punter Sean West delivered what HaterReport called 'No BS this might be the greatest punt OF ALL TIME' per HaterReport — ClutchPoints: 'DID SEAN WEST JUST DELIVER THE GREATEST PUNT IN COLLEGE FOOTBALL HISTORY?!' The punt: ClutchPoints/HaterReport video shows it. StatMuse: Notre Dame RBs Kedrick Williams 21 touches, 101 total yards, 2 total TDs; Elijah James Jr 11 touches, 86 total yards, 1 total TD. BarstoolBigCat postgame: 'I think we're better but that was an ugly second half. Notre Dame is for real, not exactly breaking news, thought that last year and all offseason.' HaterReport on Freeman: 'Marcus Freeman you DON'T have to do this 😭😭 Bro has NO SHAME lmaoo' and 'Marcus Freeman popping out with a fresh cut for the Notre Dame vs Wisconsin game.' RedditCFB: 'Per sources, Notre Dame had a heated discussion at halftime in a close 13-10 game and decided to go for broke and sell out to beat Wisconsin or call it a season. The gamble worked, and Notre Dame will be back to play Rice next week.' (This is satire, but the blowout was real.) The controversy: Freeman going for it on 4th & 1 up 28 late. Why? Statement game, rivalry, Freeman sending a message? Wisconsin's perspective: classless, running up the score. BarstoolBigCat also noted refs were bad: 'What the fuck are these refs doing? It's not enough that Notre Dame is a 21 point favorite and loaded? Pieces of shit' and 'This game is under personal protest' and 'That's INSANE. Every single person saw no control. What the fuck are we doing?!?!?' (referring to a catch review where everyone saw no control but refs upheld it). Wisconsin had a shot — BarstoolBigCat: 'I'm just so fucking happy the Badgers are a physical football team again.' But Notre Dame pulled away in second half. The greatest punt ever: research if Sean West's punt is actually in the conversation for best CFB punt ever — hang time, pin, situation. Freeman's decision to go for it up 28 — compare to other 'classless' late-game decisions (Oregon vs Colorado 2023, etc). Is Freeman building a reputation as ruthless? Wisconsin at Lambeau — how rare is it for Wisconsin to play a 'home' game at Lambeau and get blown out? Notre Dame RBs combined for 187 total yards and 3 TDs — the ground game dominated. BarstoolBigCat: 'Annnnnd Dead. Welp. Still like what I saw but can't do that against a way better team.' Meme concept: Wisconsin thinking they had a chance (first half close) vs Notre Dame pulling away and then twisting the knife (4th down conversion up 28).

supporting_stories.topic: Gerrit Cole becomes first pitcher in MLB history to allow back-to-back-to-back homers to open game TWICE in career — Padres sweep Yankees
supporting_stories.headline: Cole makes history again, wrong kind

tweets.text: Gerrit Cole is the only pitcher in MLB history to allow back-to-back-to-back home runs to the first three batters of a game more than once in a career

supporting_stories.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Padres beat Yankees 4-3 per ground truth. Gerrit Cole allowed back-to-back-to-back home runs to Fernando Tatis Jr, Jake Cronenworth, and a third batter to open the game per TalkinBaseball. TalkinBaseball: 'Gerrit Cole is the only pitcher in MLB history to allow back-to-back-to-back home runs to the first three batters of a game more than once in a career.' This is the SECOND time Cole has done this — the first was earlier this season (or last season, check story history). Yesterday's story covered the first time; today is the second occurrence, making Cole the only pitcher in MLB history to do this twice. SleeperHQ: 'The Padres just put Gerrit Cole in an MLB the Show moment 😭' (video). The absurdity: Cole is a former Cy Young winner, one of the best pitchers of his generation, and he's now the only pitcher EVER to allow 1-2-3 homers to open a game twice. Yankees lost 4-3, Padres completed sweep per ground truth. Research: when was the first time Cole allowed back-to-back-to-back homers to open a game? (Check story history — it happened earlier this season.) How rare is it for a pitcher to allow even ONE set of 1-2-3 homers to open a game? Cole is now alone in history with two. Yankees' season: they are struggling, Padres swept them. Cole's contract: $324M, nine years remaining. Is this the beginning of the end for Cole? He's 35 years old. Tatis and Cronenworth: both went deep, who was the third batter? (TalkinBaseball video shows all three.) The meme: Cole's face after the third homer. The cross-sport angle: Cole is now in the same category as all-time collapses — research other athletes who became the 'only player in history' to do something embarrassing twice (e.g., Jadeveon Clowney only player to be offsides on consecutive plays in Super Bowl). The Yankees' perspective: they just got swept by the Padres, Cole gave up three homers before recording an out. The Padres' perspective: revenge for… what? Research if there's Yankees-Padres beef. Gif concept: disbelief, head-in-hands, 'how did this happen again' — Cole after the third homer.
